page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Above the text: page number and an ornamental band. Title block at the top, then the body text in paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left. No margin notes.

main_text.head: IUDICIORUM PUBLICORUM SIVE SCABINATUS IN FLORENTISSIMA REPUBLICA DANTISCANA PRAESIDI AMPLISSIMO, ET ASSESSORIBUS SPECTATISSIMIS ATQUE INTEGERRIMIS, Dominis ac Patronis honorandis
main_text.p: PRIMAM fuisse apud veteres cu-ram, ut Pueri in Mathesi prius instituerentur, quam ad reliquas artes admitterentur, plus quam vulgatum est, VIRI AMPLISS. SPECTABILISS. INTEGERRIMI. Cum enim ex Pythagorae, Socratis atque Platonis religione, ut & Pindari aliorumque diuinorum Poetarum oraculis, omne ani-

page.notes: The ornamental band above the title is decorative and not transcribed. The initial P of "Primam" is a large drop capital, joined to the word. The 'ut' in the body is set in a special form and is given as "ut". Lines marked "S.D.P." are set in italic capitals and small type. The title is set in mixed sizes and spacing; it is given as one heading. No marginal notes are printed.
